description: Protects the shared files of a manuscript project (a folder with .manuscript/project.json) — refuses overwriting completion records · refuses hand-registered new open-item IDs · sync check guard · post-write snapshots · notice of broken tracker table rows. Exits at once in other folders. Implementation: skills/new-manuscript/hooks/guard_write.py; rules: manuscript-workflow/references/tracker-workflow.md "Sync — several computers write the shared files".

hooks.command: case "$(uname -s)" in MINGW*|MSYS*|CYGWIN*) PY=python;; *) PY=python3;; esac; "$PY" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/new-manuscript/hooks/guard_write.py" pre
case "$(uname -s)" in MINGW*|MSYS*|CYGWIN*) PY=python;; *) PY=python3;; esac; "$PY" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/new-manuscript/hooks/guard_write.py" post
